headline: BigX naming his album “Better Over Time” and proving just how much he’s improved is crazy
body: BigX naming his album “Better Over Time” and proving just how much he’s improved is crazy BigXthaPlug naming his fourth album “Better Over Time” and then actually proving the title right is crazy. Since breaking out with “Texas” in 2022, you can hear how much he’s grown as a rapper, and now the new album has reached 1 on the US Apple Music Top Albums Chart. With over 10. 7 billion global streams behind him, BigX has seriously levelled up over the last few years.
